items.title: Stock Radar: SBI Cards & Payment Services stock showing signs of trend reversal after falling over 30% from highs
items.description: SBI Cards & Payment Services has shown signs of a potential trend reversal after bouncing back from key support levels. Technical indicators suggest improving momentum, with experts recommending high-risk traders consider buying the stock on dips for a target of Rs 700 in the coming weeks.

items.title: Top Nifty50 stocks analysts suggest buying in this volatile week
items.description: Stock Reports Plus, powered by Refinitiv, is a comprehensive report that evaluates five key components of 4,000+ listed stocks – earnings, fundamentals, relative valuation, risk, and price momentum – to generate standardised scores. The simple average of the above-mentioned five component ratings is normally distributed to reach an average score.

items.title: Emmvee Photovoltaic among 5 stocks closed below VWAP, signalling bearish shift
items.description: On July 17, the closing prices of five stocks in the Nifty500 pack dropped more than 1.5% below their Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP), according to StockEdge's technical scan data. A move below the VWAP suggests a potential bearish trend, as it indicates that the stock is trading below its average price for the session after accounting for trading volumes.When the closing price falls below the VWAP, it means the closing price is lower than the average price at which the stock traded throughout the day, with the average weighted by trading volume. Traders and investors often interpret this as a bearish signal, reflecting increasing selling pressure and the possibility of continued downside momentum.

items.title: Federal Bank among 5 stocks closed above VWAP, signalling bullish shift
items.description: On July 17, the closing prices of five stocks in the Nifty500 pack rallied more than 1.5% above their Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP), according to StockEdge's technical scan data. A move above the VWAP suggests a potential bullish trend, as it indicates that the stock is trading above its average price for the session after accounting for trading volumes.When the closing price rises above the VWAP, it signifies that the closing price is higher than the average price at which the stock was traded throughout the day, with the average weighted by trading volume. Traders and investors often interpret this as a bullish signal, reflecting positive market sentiment and the possibility of continued upward momentum.

items.title: Jio Financial Services among 6 stocks showing bullish RSI upswing
items.description: On July 17, six stocks in the Nifty500 segment that gained over 2.5% were highlighted in the RSI Trending Up scan, based on data from StockEdge.com. An uptrend signal is generated when the RSI value crosses above 50 from lower levels. “RSI trending up” indicates that Relative Strength Index (RSI) values are rising, suggesting strengthening momentum in the stock’s price action. This can indicate potential upward movement and is often used by traders to identify buying opportunities in momentum-driven markets.

items.title: Stock split alert! Last day to buy this smallcap stock that rallied 580% in 3 years. Do you own?
items.description: According to SEBI's T+1 settlement cycle, investors must buy a company's shares at least one trading day before the record date to ensure the shares are credited to their demat accounts in time, and they become eligible for the corporate action.

items.title: Positive Breakout: These 9 stocks cross above their 200 DMAs
items.description: In the NSE list of stocks with a market cap over Rs 10,000 crore, nine stocks' closing prices crossed above their 200 DMA (Daily Moving Averages) on July 17, 2026, according to stockedge.com's technical scan data. Traders use the 200-day daily moving average (DMA) as a key indicator for determining the overall trend in a particular stock. As long as the stock is priced above the 200-day SMA on the daily timeframe, it is generally considered to be in an overall uptrend. Take a look:

items.title: Nifty ready for 24,500-24,750 levels after breakout rally: Analysts
items.description: Analysts expect the rally to extend towards 24,500-24,750, with some seeing the potential for 25,000, although they believe the index must first overcome resistance around the 24,350-24,600 zone. The index closed at 24,334 on Friday.

items.title: Stocks in news: ICICI Bank, YES Bank, Kotak Bank, RIL, Axis Bank
items.description: Markets advanced Friday, gaining over one percent despite weak global cues. Analysts await quarterly results from Reliance Industries, HDFC Bank, and ICICI Bank. ICICI Bank reported a 16% year-on-year net profit increase for the June quarter. YES Bank and PNB also posted significant year-on-year profit growth. Kotak Mahindra Bank and Axis Bank also announced their first-quarter financial results.

items.title: D-St set for a negative opening as GIFT Nifty signals weak start
items.description: Domestic equities ended the week on a strong note, with Nifty rising. Analysts expect a gradual uptrend next week, driven by strong Q1 earnings. Investor focus will remain on management commentary and earnings reactions. India VIX fell, indicating reduced market fear. Foreign investors were net buyers of shares on Friday.

items.title: Carnelian Capital plans PE foray with Rs 2,000 crore fund
items.description: The investment manager, which oversees about ₹18,300 crore across portfolio management services and alternative investment funds, plans to raise the maiden fund in the next 12-18 months. It will focus on profitable companies seeking ₹100-300 crore of growth capital, a segment the firm believes has become underserved as private equity funds have grown larger.

items.title: Select mid & smallcaps on a roll, but broader market lags
items.description: Nifty Midcap 150 reached a record high, and Smallcap 250 neared its peak.  However, the broader market breadth shows a weak trend with few gainers.  Concentrated fund flows into mid and small caps are driving select indices higher.  Foreign institutional investors have exited bluechips, causing the Nifty 50 to underperform.  The market is in a consolidation phase, awaiting improved buying interest in largecaps.

items.title: Axis Bank weighs raising stake in its insurance venture to 30%
items.description: In June 2026, Axis Bank announced a further investment of up to ?381 crore in Axis Max Life Insurance, taking the combined shareholding of Axis Bank and its subsidiaries-Axis Capital and Axis Securities-from 19.02% to 19.99%. Max Financial Services holds 80.01%.

items.title: Regional conflict-driven curbs weigh on flow: FCNR(B) inflows may miss initial estimates, says HDFC Bank CEO
items.description: Expected FCNR(B) deposit inflows are now projected at fifty to fifty-five billion dollars.  Taxation complexities for nonresidents and tighter West Asian liquidity are impacting these mobilizations.  Early estimates had not fully factored in the tax impact on non-resident Indians.  The Reserve Bank of India's special incentives for this program will conclude on September thirtieth.  HDFC Bank is pursuing a three-pronged approach to maximize its deposit mobilization efforts.

items.title: India Inc is returning to banks for money, but retail borrowers aren’t keeping pace
items.description: India’s largest private banks are witnessing a shift in credit demand, with corporate and SME lending driving loan growth while retail borrowing remains subdued. Stronger working capital demand, refinancing and business banking boosted advances, but slower consumer credit growth and weaker CASA ratios continue to weigh on banks’ funding mix and margins.

items.title: Paytm likely to announce its first-ever bonus issue today: What lies ahead for its 7.5 lakh retail shareholders?
items.description: Paytm's parent company will announce its first bonus share issue today. This announcement coincides with the release of its Q1 FY27 earnings report. Domestic investors have increased their stake in the fintech platform significantly. The company reported its first full-year profit in FY26. Global brokerages maintain a positive outlook on Paytm's stock performance.

items.title: PB Fintech among 5 F&O stocks with a sharp rise in futures open interest
items.description: As of July 17, there was a notable surge in futures open interest for nine stocks in the NSE F&O pack, contributing to a total increase in open interest of over 5% as compared to the previous trade. A significant uptick in futures open interest signifies substantial growth in the number of active, unexpired futures contracts for a specific security. This uptrend reflects an increasing number of participants either initiating new positions or expanding the size of their existing positions within the futures market.

items.title: BHEL share price: Brokerages see up to 23% upside after Maharatna PSU posts first Q1 profit in 8 years
items.description: BHEL shares recently hit a 52-week high, but brokerages see more upside after the Maharatna PSU posted its first June-quarter profit in eight years. Strong execution, a robust Rs 2.6 lakh crore order book and improving margins have prompted ICICI Securities and JM Financial to reiterate their bullish outlook on the stock.

items.title: Tips Music shares jump 11% as board set to approve buyback on July 22
items.description: Tips Music shares jumped up to 11% after the company announced that its board will consider a proposal to buy back equity shares alongside approving its June quarter results on July 22. The announcement comes after the music label delivered strong FY26 earnings growth and continued to expand its music catalogue and digital audience.

items.title: VA Tech Wabag shares rise 4% after securing major Bengaluru wastewater treatment order
items.description: VA Tech Wabag shares rose after announcing a significant order from BWSSB. The company will develop two energy-efficient wastewater treatment facilities in Bengaluru. This large order strengthens its position in India's municipal wastewater sector. The projects will enhance sewage treatment capacity and water security goals. VA Tech Wabag's stock has shown strong performance over recent months.

items.title: PC Jeweller shares jump 6%: What’s driving the rally after 220% gains in 3 years?
items.description: PC Jeweller shares jumped about 6% after its board approved raising up to Rs 1,000 crore through a QIP, nearly reversing Friday’s losses. The rebound also comes amid strong Q1 revenue growth and the company’s progress toward becoming debt-free.

items.title: Rs 91,000 crore wipeout: What spooked HDFC Bank, Axis Bank and Kotak investors even as credit growth picked up?
items.description: Nearly Rs 91,000 crore was wiped off the market value of HDFC Bank, Axis Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank as stronger credit growth failed to offset concerns over shrinking net interest margins, weaker CASA deposits and leadership uncertainty. ICICI Bank bucked the trend, supported by resilient profitability and balanced loan growth.

items.title: Kotak Mahindra Bank shares fall over 3% despite Q1 profit growth. Analysts weigh in
items.description: Kotak Mahindra Bank shares fell after reporting a strong profit increase for the first quarter. Net profit rose 26% year-on-year, and net interest income also saw growth. Asset quality improved from the previous year, though key ratios weakened sequentially. Brokerages provided varied ratings, with some reiterating buy recommendations and others maintaining add ratings. Analysts cited controlled slippages and credit costs as positive factors supporting the bank's performance.

items.title: PNB shares jump 6% as Q1 profit soars 214%, beats Street estimates. What next?
items.description: Punjab National Bank shares rose sharply on Monday after the PSU lender reported a 214% YoY jump in Q1FY27 net profit, beating Street estimates. Strong asset quality, lower provisions and improving margins prompted JM Financial to upgrade the stock and Motilal Oswal to reiterate its Buy rating with a higher target.

items.title: Natco Pharma shares surge 5% after US FDA's tentative nod Olaparib tablets
items.description: Natco Pharma shares rose sharply on Monday after the U.S. FDA granted tentative approval for its generic Olaparib tablets, a bioequivalent version of AstraZeneca’s Lynparza. The drug addresses a $1.4-billion U.S. market opportunity. The company will manufacture the product, while Alembic Pharmaceuticals will handle its U.S. commercialisation.

items.title: Yes Bank shares drop 4% after Q1 results. What are Nuvama, other brokerages saying?
items.description: Yes Bank shares fell despite reporting a 34% year-on-year jump in Q1FY27 standalone net profit to Rs 1,071 crore. Net interest income (NII) rose 17.5% YoY to Rs 2,786 crore, but the strong earnings failed to lift investor sentiment.

items.title: Axis Bank shares fall 5% after Q1 earnings fail to cheer D-Street. What brokerages say
items.description: Axis Bank shares fell despite reporting a 22.5% year-on-year rise in Q1FY27 standalone net profit to Rs 7,114 crore. Net interest income (NII) grew over 8% YoY to Rs 14,646 crore, beating some brokerage estimates, but mixed analyst views and concerns over margins weighed on investor sentiment.

items.title: Reliance Industries share price target: What are brokerages saying after Q1 results?
items.description: Reliance Industries shares gained after the conglomerate reported better-than-expected June quarter earnings, driven by robust growth across its energy, digital and refining businesses. Brokerages remained bullish on the stock, with several reiterating Buy ratings and raising target prices, citing strong operational performance, improving refining margins and long-term growth prospects across Jio, retail and renewable energy.

items.title: Why is market falling today? Sensex slumps 600 points, Nifty tests 24,200. 6 factors behind the selloff
items.description: Indian stock markets traded lower on Monday, impacted by Iran-US tensions.  Sensex and Nifty experienced significant declines, reflecting investor concerns over rising oil prices.  Tech Mahindra and Bharti Airtel shares saw gains, while Axis and HDFC Bank shares dropped.  Broader markets also traded with marginal losses, with private banks leading the decline.  Despite the overall dip, market breadth showed a slightly positive trend with more advances than declines.

items.title: Ashish Kacholia, Mukul Agrawal, other ace investors sell smallcaps again in Q1. Should you worry?
items.description: Ace investors Ashish Kacholia, Mukul Agrawal, Dolly Khanna, and Madhusudan Kela were net sellers of small-cap stocks in Q1 FY27, booking profits after a strong market rally and trimming weaker holdings. Analysts remain selectively bullish, recommending fundamentally strong small- and mid-cap stocks while cautioning that elevated valuations leave limited room for disappointment.

items.title: Som Distilleries shares jump 14% as ace investor Prashant Jain buys 25 lakh shares in Q1. What is he seeing?
items.description: Shares of Som Distilleries surged after veteran investor Prashant Jain acquired a 1.22% stake in the company during the June quarter, according to the latest shareholding data. The investment boosted investor sentiment despite the liquor maker reporting weak earnings in the previous quarter.

items.title: Stock picks of the week: 5 stocks with consistent score improvement and upside potential of up to 28%
items.description: It may take a while for clarity to emerge in the Gulf region. In the meantime, focus on fundamentals and how they pan out in the next couple of months in light of the US-Iran war and the changed economic scenario. Our selected stocks for today depict a strong upward trajectory in their overall average score which is based on five key pillars: Earnings, fundamentals, relative valuation, risk, and price momentum. This implies that there has been a significant improvement in their market outlook in the given time frame.

items.title: 101 mutual funds doubled money in 5 years. Are they still worth buying?
items.description: Over 100 mutual funds doubled investors' money in five years, led by infrastructure and PSU funds with returns of up to 188%. But recent performance has weakened sharply, highlighting the risks of chasing past winners. Experts say sectoral themes move in cycles and advise investors to favour diversified funds over concentrated bets, while staying positive on financials, healthcare, infrastructure and defence for the long term.

items.title: FIIs and mutual funds increase stakes in Groww. Should you buy, sell, or hold?
items.description: Groww's parent, Billionbrains Garage Ventures, saw FIIs and mutual funds raise stakes in Q1FY27 as net profit surged 94% YoY, prompting Jefferies, JM Financial and Motilal Oswal to set a Rs 250 target price, implying about 21% upside from current levels.

items.title: HDFC Bank shares crash 5%, wipe off Rs 70,000 cr from investor wealth. Why Jefferies, Nomura, others see up to 28% upside?
items.description: HDFC Bank shares fell sharply on Monday after its Q1FY27 earnings failed to impress investors, wiping out nearly Rs 70,000 crore in market value. Despite margin pressure and a muted market reaction, brokerages including Jefferies, Nomura, Motilal Oswal and Anand Rathi retained bullish ratings, seeing up to 28% upside in the stock.

items.title: Goldman Sachs initiates coverage on Sansera Engineering, 3 other auto ancillary stocks with upside of up to 28%. Here’s why
items.description: Goldman Sachs has initiated coverage on four Indian auto ancillary companies, turning bullish on Sansera Engineering and Craftsman Automation while assigning Neutral ratings to Bharat Forge and Samvardhana Motherson. The brokerage believes a shift towards precision engineering, aerospace, defence, semiconductors and EV-related opportunities will drive long-term growth and improve margins.

items.title: Bonus bonanza! Aastha Spintex to consider bonus issue, dividend less than a month since debut on July 23
items.description: Aastha Spintex will consider a 1:1 bonus issue, a final FY26 dividend of up to Rs 10 per share, and textile expansion plans on July 23. Despite shares falling over 22% below the IPO price, the company aims to strengthen long-term growth through forward integration.

items.title: Sona BLW Precision among 6 midcap stocks that hit 52-week highs, rally up to 20% in a month
items.description: Benchmark Sensex closed 443 points lower at 77,708 on Monday. Despite the weak broader market sentiment, six stocks from the BSE 150 MidCap Index scaled fresh 52-week highs, reaching their strongest levels in the past year. A stock hitting a 52-week high is widely viewed as a bullish technical signal, indicating strong buying interest, improving investor sentiment, and sustained upward momentum in its price performance.

items.title: Market wrap: Trent, Axis Bank among top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex today
items.description: Indian equities ended lower as escalating Iran-US tensions and surging crude prices dampened investor sentiment despite easing volatility. Banking stocks dragged benchmarks, while analysts expect geopolitical risks, inflation concerns and Q1 earnings momentum to shape market direction, with Nifty support at 24,100 and resistance near 24,400.

items.title: Mrs Bectors Food shares surge 25% in 3 days after Sunil Singhania's Abakkus picks up  stake
items.description: Mrs Bectors Food Specialities shares surged on Monday, extending their three-day gains to over 25% after Sunil Singhania's Abakkus Investment Managers acquired a nearly 1% stake through a bulk deal. Investors cheered the marquee investment even as the company awaits its June quarter earnings announcement.

items.title: ​Multibagger smallcaps: FIIs raised stakes in these 14 stocks for 2 straight quarters; shares soared up to 450%
items.description: Tracking the investment moves of Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) can provide valuable insights, as their decisions are typically backed by extensive research and analysis. Shareholding trends over the last two consecutive quarters—from December 2025 to March 2026 and from March 2026 to June 2026—show that FIIs steadily increased their stakes in around 151 companies in the BSE smallcap segment.Notably, 43 of these stocks have delivered returns of more than 50% over the past six months. Among them, we have highlighted 14 stocks that generated returns ranging from 100% to 450%, effectively doubling—and in some cases multiplying several times—investors' wealth within a short period. (Data Source: ACE Equity)

items.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Tuesday
items.description: Indian markets ended lower as escalating Iran-US tensions and rising crude prices weighed on sentiment. Analysts expect geopolitical risks, inflation and central bank actions to remain in focus, while resilient Q1 earnings support selective opportunities. Nifty faces resistance at 24,400 and support near 24,100.

items.title: Weekly Top Picks: These stocks scored 10 on 10 on Stock Reports Plus

In addition to detailed company analyses, the report also collates analysts’ forecasts and trend analysis for each component. An average score in Stock Reports Plus is calculated by undertaking quantitative analysis of five key investment tools – earnings, fundamentals, relative valuation, risk, and price momentum.

items.title: Market Trading Guide: Lloyds Metals among 2 stock recommendations for Tuesday
items.description: Markets remain cautious amid rising geopolitical tensions, higher crude prices and inflation concerns. Despite global headwinds, encouraging Q1 earnings support sentiment. Analysts recommend buying Jana Small Finance Bank and Lloyds Metals after bullish technical breakouts backed by strong volumes and positive moving averages.

items.title: Sebi imposes Rs 1 crore penalty on CDSL over 2022 malware attack
items.description: Sebi has imposed a Rs 1 crore penalty on CDSL for cybersecurity failures that enabled a 2022 malware attack, disrupting depository operations and market settlements. The regulator cited inadequate protection of critical systems, weak access controls and poor security monitoring despite prescribed cybersecurity requirements.
